output.scope_note: The paper is about the Li/LiPON interphase and reports one measured ionic conductivity for a LiPON solid electrolyte thin film; the other conductivity values are literature table entries for SEI components, which I left out.

records.evidence_quote: Ionic conductivity of as-deposited LiPON thin film was measured by electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) to be 3×10-6 S/cm, similar to that in literature.
records.notes: As-deposited 1 μm RF-sputtered LiPON thin film from a Li3PO4 target under N2. Measurement temperature is not stated. Conductivity kind is not specified (thin-film EIS). The Supplementary Table 2 ionic conductivities of SEI components (Li2O, Li3N, Li3PO4, etc.) were skipped because the table layout is garbled and their columns cannot be reliably matched to compounds.
